text:
erin: Quick QA pass on the registration widget before we push the ad traffic tonight. want to confirm tracking + legal bits.

leo: I'll run through it now. main checks: hidden event_id, utm_source, consent checkbox, and webhook payload to our HubSpot endpoint.

nina: notes from dev: widget supports `hiddenFields: { event_id, campaign, affiliate }` and we can map them to lead props. also added `consent_text` slot for the privacy copy.

chris: Legal approved this copy for consent: "I agree to receive marketing emails and product updates from Redwood Inference." Nina, please make checkbox required and store boolean in lead metadata.

leo: Quick test payload I used: `POST /api/leads` body: `{ email: "test+reg@redwood.ai", event_id: "2026-04-05-launch", utm_source: "twitter_ad", consent: true }` — hubspot mapping shows event_id populating.

erin: Great. Can we also auto-append `reg_ts` and `reg_variant` (control vs treatment) to the webhook so we can segment A/B later?

nina: yes, we added `reg_ts` unix epoch. reg_variant pulled from cookie `reg_variant` if present, default=control.

chris: For replay routing: plan is to tag people who watch >50% as "engaged_replay" and fire a separate nurture. Who owns the watch tracking?

leo: Playback tracking owned by video infra. I'll surface an endpoint that returns view percentages. We'll push events `video.playback` with `percent_complete` to our events pipeline.

erin: Can we keep the replay watch tag out of early sales notifications? only live attendees should go to AE queue. Replay viewers go to nurture with an SLA of 5 days before sales touch.

chris: Agreed. Add condition: if attendee_live=true then push to sales immediately; else if percent_complete>=50 then assign tag and wait 48-72h drip.

nina: Ops note: make sure the registration confirmation email includes the canonical replay URL and includes `?event_id=2026-04-05-launch` so UTM joins with playback events. sample link: `https://redwood.ai/replay/2026-04-05-launch?ref=reg`

leo: Also recommend we mint short links for social so utm_source is consistent. I'll create bit.ly links: bit.ly/rdw-launch1 etc.

erin: Ops-bot can you schedule a reminder for dev to run the widget QA 2 hours before ad push?

ops-bot: Reminder set for 2026-04-05 18:00 UTC :alarm_clock: (task: widget QA + hubspot mapping verification)

chris: Who's owner for the post-event clip + transcript cadence? erin? or leo?

erin: I'll own clip approval. leo will coordinate the captions export. we'll split social edits after final cut.

nina: one last thing: privacy checkbox must link to privacy.redwood.ai/policy and include GDPR language for EU regs. I'm adding that now.

erin: Perfect. thanks all — closing this thread, will pin the widget QA steps to the event board.
